jobs.title: Data Engineer | Talent Community
jobs.description: Job Description Data Engineer | Talent Community We Are Lennar Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders and a Fortune 500® company with a growing technology organization focused on innovation, data, digital experiences, and technology that helps shape the future of homebuilding. Data is at the center of that transformation. We're investing in modern data platforms and engineering capabilities that enable better decisions, smarter products, greater operational efficiency, and new ways of using data across the organization. Build Your Future in Data Engineering at Lennar We're always looking to connect with talented Data Engineers who are excited about building the platforms and products that turn data into something our teams can use to make better decisions. This is a proactive talent community opportunity for Data Engineers interested in exploring future opportunities with Lennar. While we may not have an immediate opening that matches your background, we'd like to get to know you and stay connected as our Enterprise Data & Analytics organization continues to grow. Whether your expertise is in data platforms, data pipelines, cloud data engineering, data architecture, data integration, streaming, analytics engineering, or another area of data engineering , we welcome the opportunity to learn more about your experience and career interests. What You Could Work On Depending on your background and future opportunities within the team, you may contribute to: Design, build, and operationalize scalable data engineering solutions for Lennar's data platforms and products. Build and optimize ETL and ELT pipelines that bring together data from diverse sources. Develop data ingestion and integration solutions using batch, incremental, change data capture (CDC), streaming, and API-based approaches. Design and implement data models, data warehouses, data lakes, and modern cloud data platforms. Build reliable, reusable, and maintainable data transformation processes that enable analysts, data scientists, and business teams to work with trusted data. Improve data quality, reliability, observability, monitoring, and error handling across data pipelines and platforms. Develop automated testing, CI/CD workflows, version control practices, and other engineering standards that improve the quality and speed of delivery. Partner with data analysts, data scientists, product teams, software engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data solutions that support real business outcomes. Help create self-service data capabilities that make it easier for teams across Lennar to access and use data. Contribute to data governance, security, compliance, and access-control practices. Troubleshoot complex data and platform issues and identify opportunities to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability. Stay current with emerging data technologies and engineering practices and help identify opportunities to apply them at Lennar. The Technologies You Could Work With Our data environment continues to evolve, and future opportunities may span a variety of technologies, platforms, and architectural approaches. Depending on the role and team, experience with technologies such as the following may be relevant: AWS, including services such as S3, EMR, Glue, Lambda, EKS, EC2, and CloudWatch Snowflake and modern cloud data warehouse technologies dbt and modern analytics engineering practices SQL and Python ETL/ELT, data ingestion, CDC, REST APIs, and streaming Airflow, Prefect, or other orchestration and scheduling technologies GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and modern software development practices Data modeling, data warehousing, data lakes, and data architecture Data governance, security, access controls, and data quality Data replication and integration technologies such as Qlik Replicate You don't need experience with every technology listed. We're interested in understanding the data challenges you've solved, the platforms you've built, and the technologies you're excited to work with next. What We're Looking For We're interested in connecting with Data Engineers across a range of experience levels and specialties who bring: Professional experience designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, platforms, products, or related engineering solutions. Strong understanding of data engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, transformation, ingestion, testing, monitoring, and data quality. Strong SQL skills and experience with one or more programming languages, such as Python. Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and modern data engineering technologies. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to break down complex technical challenges. The ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and data consumers. A growth mindset and willingness to learn new technologies, tools, and approaches. An interest in understanding the business context behind the data and building solutions that create meaningful business value. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent professional experience. For more senior opportunities, experience with data architecture, technical leadership, mentoring, platform strategy, and designing highly scalable data solutions may also be relevant. Why Join Lennar? At Lennar, you'll have the opportunity to work on data challenges within a large, complex organization while helping build the capabilities that support our evolution into a more data and insights-driven company. You'll collaborate with professionals across data, analytics, software engineering, product, cybersecurity, and business functions , giving you the opportunity to work across a broad technology ecosystem and see how the solutions you build translate into real business impact. We're building a data organization that values technical excellence, problem solving, ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning . As our data capabilities evolve, so do the opportunities for engineers to expand their expertise, take on meaningful challenges, and build a career with impact. Interested in What's Next? This is a proactive posting for our Data Engineering talent community and is not tied to a specific current opening. By expressing your interest, you'll have an opportunity to introduce yourself to our team and be considered for future Data Engineering opportunities that align with your experience, technical interests, and career goals. We'd love to learn more about you and stay connected as our Enterprise Data & Analytics organization grows. Physical & Office/Site Presence Requirements This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. Travel may be required, up to 10% of the time, to locations within the Lennar family of companies. This description outlines the basic responsibilities and requirements for the position noted. This is not a comprehensive listing of all job duties. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. #IND-TECH Life at Lennar At Lennar, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching environment for our Associates, offering a comprehensive array of benefits designed to enhance their well-being and professional growth. Our Associates have access to robust health insurance plans, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage, ensuring their health needs are well taken care of. Our 401(k) Retirement Plan, complete with a $1 for $1 Company Match up to 5%, helps secure their financial future, while Paid Parental Leave and an Associate Assistance Plan provide essential support during life's critical moments. To further support our Associates, we provide an Education Assistance Program and up to $30,000 in Adoption Assistance, underscoring our commitment to their diverse needs and aspirations. From the moment of hire, they can enjoy up to three weeks of vacation annually, alongside generous Holiday, Sick Leave, and Personal Day policies. Additionally, we offer a New Hire Referral Bonus Program, significant Home Purchase Discounts, and unique opportunities such as the Everyone’s Included Day. At Lennar, we believe in investing in our Associates, empowering them to thrive both personally and professionally. Lennar Associates will have access to these benefits as outlined by Lennar’s policies and applicable plan terms. Visit Lennartotalrewards.com to view our suite of benefits. Join the fun and follow us on social media to see what's happening at our company, and don't forget to connect with us on Lennar: Overview | LinkedIn<https://www.linkedin.com/company/lennar/> for the latest job opportunities. Lennar is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Apply

jobs.title: Snowflake Data Engineer
jobs.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Snowflake Data Engineer based in the United States. As a Snowflake Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize cloud-based data solutions that transform raw information into reliable, actionable insights. You will build and maintain data pipelines, integrate information from multiple enterprise sources, and develop efficient data models to support analytics and business intelligence initiatives. Working in a remote, project-driven environment, you will collaborate with technical teams to ensure data quality, scalability, and performance across cloud data platforms. You will leverage SQL and modern ETL/ELT practices to streamline data processing and improve warehouse efficiency. This opportunity is ideal for a technically minded professional who enjoys solving complex data challenges and building maintainable, high-performing data infrastructure. The role offers the flexibility of remote work in the United States under a contract-based employment arrangement. Accountabilities Cloud Data Warehouse Development: Develop, maintain, and optimize data warehouse solutions using Snowflake to support business reporting, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. Data Pipeline Engineering: Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform, and load data efficiently from multiple enterprise source systems into Snowflake. SQL Development & Optimization: Write, test, and optimize complex SQL queries and data transformations to improve processing efficiency, query performance, and overall warehouse utilization. Data Integration: Integrate data from diverse sources, ensuring consistent, reliable, and accessible information across the organization's data ecosystem. Data Modeling & Transformation: Develop and maintain data models, structured datasets, and analytical data layers that meet reporting and business intelligence requirements. Python-Based Development: Where applicable, use Python, Snowflake stored procedures, and user-defined functions to automate workflows and implement advanced data processing logic. Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve data quality issues, pipeline failures, query bottlenecks, and warehouse performance challenges. Cloud Platform & Tool Integration: Work with cloud infrastructure, orchestration tools, and data transformation technologies to support reliable and scalable data workflows. Security & Access Management: Support Snowflake security configurations, role-based access controls, and warehouse settings to maintain appropriate data access and platform performance. Continuous Improvement: Apply engineering best practices to improve pipeline reliability, maintainability, scalability, and the overall efficiency of data operations. Requirements Snowflake Experience: Hands-on experience developing, implementing, or supporting data solutions on Snowflake, including cloud data warehouse environments. SQL Proficiency: Strong SQL skills, with demonstrated ability to develop complex queries, implement data transformations, troubleshoot issues, and optimize query performance. ETL/ELT Pipeline Development: Practical experience designing, developing, maintaining, or supporting ETL/ELT pipelines for reliable data ingestion and transformation. Data Integration Skills: Experience connecting and consolidating information from multiple source systems into centralized data platforms. Data Warehousing & Modeling: Understanding of data warehouse architecture, data modeling principles, and the development of datasets for analytics and reporting. Troubleshooting & Performance Optimization: Ability to investigate data discrepancies, diagnose pipeline failures, and improve the performance and reliability of data workflows. Python & Advanced Snowflake Capabilities: Familiarity with Python, Snowflake stored procedures, or user-defined functions is preferred. Data Integration Tools: Experience with Matillion or other data integration and orchestration platforms is an advantage. Cloud & Transformation Technologies: Familiarity with AWS, dbt, or IBM DataStage is desirable. Snowflake Administration & Security: Knowledge of role-based access controls, security configurations, and virtual warehouse management is beneficial. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong attention to detail, logical thinking, and the ability to resolve technical challenges in complex data environments. Collaboration & Communication: Ability to work effectively with technical stakeholders, communicate technical issues clearly, and contribute to collaborative project delivery. Work Arrangement: Must be able to work remotely from the United States under a contract-based arrangement. Candidates should be prepared to provide their current location and work authorization details during the application process. Benefits Competitive Contract Rate: Indicative hourly compensation of $46–$56 per hour, depending on experience, technical skills, and project requirements. Remote Work Flexibility: Work remotely from within the United States. Contract-Based Opportunity: Gain experience delivering cloud data engineering solutions in a project-oriented environment. In-Demand Technical Skills: Apply and strengthen expertise in Snowflake, SQL, ETL/ELT, data modeling, and cloud data platforms. Exposure to Modern Data Technologies: Opportunities to work with complementary technologies such as Python, AWS, dbt, Matillion, and other integration tools, depending on project needs. Technical Growth: Develop practical experience in data pipeline optimization, cloud warehouse performance, data integration, and scalable data architecture. Collaborative Environment: Work alongside technical professionals to solve data challenges and deliver reliable, maintainable data solutions. Employment Type: Contract. Experience Level: Entry-level listing, with hands-on Snowflake and data engineering experience required. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: ETL Engineer – Cloud Data Lakehouse & Pipeline Development
jobs.description: Position Summary We are modernizing our data platform on Azure and seeking an ETL Engineer to help build and maintain a layered data lakehouse. This is a hands-on role with a clear growth path focusing on pipeline implementation and data platform development. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines on Azure, applying modern lakehouse patterns including incremental loads and schema evolution Implement and manage a layered data architecture from raw ingestion to business-ready analytical datasets Integrate data from business systems (ERP, project management, field operations) via REST APIs and SQL source connections Build and manage pipeline workflows using tools such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or Apache Airflow Collaborate with senior leadership to implement data models and pipeline designs Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot data quality issues, and maintain logging and alerting Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, data models, and platform standards Contribute to coding, testing, and deployment best practices Participate in code reviews and grow toward broader engineering ownership over time Required Qualifications Experience in data engineering, ETL development, or a closely related field Working knowledge of layered data architecture and modern data warehouse or lakehouse patterns Strong SQL proficiency – complex queries, data modeling, and transformation logic Working knowledge of Python for scripting and data transformation; PySpark experience a strong plus Experience ingesting data from REST APIs – authentication, pagination, rate limiting, and semi-structured JSON/XML handling Experience pulling from SQL-based sources via JDBC/ODBC with incremental load strategies (watermarking, CDC) Familiarity with pipeline orchestration concepts and tools (Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, or similar) Familiarity with Azure data services (ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, or similar) Strong communication and collaboration skills Preferred Qualifications Exposure to a modern cloud data platform (Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, or similar) Additional programming language experience (C#, PowerShell, Scala, Java, or similar) Experience with pipeline orchestration tools (Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, Apache Airflow, or similar) Understanding of CDC concepts or patterns Familiarity with data catalog or governance tooling Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI Experience with ETL tooling such as SSIS, Informatica, Azure Data Factory, Databricks Workflows, or similar Exposure to construction, trades, or project-based industries Benefits Competitive salary based on experience Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) Career progression path toward Controller leadership Professional development and continuing education support Collaborative and growth-focused work environment Join a company that’s building more than just electrical systems—join a team committed to excellence and innovation. If you meet the qualifications outlined above and are ready to contribute your skills to the team at Hays Electrical Services, we encourage you to apply. Join us in providing exceptional service for our clients and supporting our company's operations. Apply now! Powered by JazzHR AsFZxIzmJA

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Company Overview Planview has one mission: to close the gap between strategic intent and business outcome, providing the intelligence organizations need to act decisively. As the global leader in Strategic Portfolio Management, Planview helps organizations of all sizes achieve their business goals, faster and smarter. Our comprehensive platform bring initiatives, investments, and resources into a continuous, connected model of the business: the actionable understanding leaders need to move decisively, keep teams and AI in lockstep, and know how their initiatives are performing.—now powered by Planview Anvi, our next-generation enterprise AI that delivers expert guidance, intelligent recommendations, and actionable insights, turning complex data into decisive action from strategy through execution. Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Strategic Portfolio Management for the fifth consecutive year, we proudly serve more than 3,000 customers globally, including 45% of the Fortune 100—and more than 3 million users worldwide. Why Join Planview? At Planview, our people’s connections drive our innovation and success. Our global team of 1,500+ employees work remotely and across offices in Austin, Vancouver, Hod HaSharon, Bangalore, Sydney, and Stockholm. We've built a world-class, connected culture rooted in shared values that empowers our teams to thrive and succeed from anywhere. When you join Planview, you're not just joining a company, you're joining a movement to transform how the world works. Discover more about our portfolio at planview.com, and connect with us on LinkedIn, Instagram, and X. The Opportunity Join our team as a Data Scientist in Austin, TX. This position will help integrate data science, optimization, and simulation capabilities within Planview's planning solutions. You will contribute to data collection and analysis, build predictive models, and work with Generative AI technologies including Planview Anvi. What You'll Do Optimization: Formulate and solve optimization problems for portfolio prioritization, investment and resource allocation, and capacity planning to maximize strategic value under constraints. Simulation: Build simulation models (e.g., Monte Carlo, discrete-event) to stress-test portfolio plans, quantify risk and uncertainty, and forecast outcomes across scenarios. Predictive Modeling: Build, test, and refine models to predict delivery timelines, portfolio outcomes, and investment performance. Agentic AI: Design MCP (Model Context Protocol) interfaces that expose optimization, simulation, and predictive capabilities to Planview Anvi and other AI agents. What You'll Bring Required Qualifications: Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field. 3-7 years experience in Python and SQL, along with familiarity with libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn. Experience with optimization and/or simulation methods (e.g., linear/integer programming, heuristics, Monte Carlo, discrete-event simulation). Demonstrated experience in translating customer challenges into data- driven product enhancements. Strong knowledge of machine learning algorithms and statistical methodologies. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with portfolio management and planning frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, Agile, Waterfall). Hands-on experience with AWS services such as Athena, SageMaker, Lambda, and Bedrock. Experience with optimization solvers or simulation libraries. Experience building with Large Language Models and agent frameworks, including exposure to the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Basic understanding of knowledge graphs and ontologies. Benefits At Planview At Planview, you’ll join our global team and culture which reflects the vibrant communities in which our employees live and work. To support you at Planview, you will enjoy: Unplugged Days: 4 company-wide paid days off per year to recharge and relax. Generous PTO offerings (region dependent). Region specific competitive benefit plans to support you at any life stage including parental leave, retirement, medical plans, wellness support, and remote work support. Paid time to volunteer through Planview’s Force for Good Week. Employee Referral bonus program. Weekly office lunches for hybrid team members and social events. Flexible work hours/environment. Now is a great time to join our team. If you are looking for a place to grow your career, innovate with best-in-class solutions, and build the future of connected work, Planview is the right place for you! Equal Employment Opportunity at Planview Planview is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. As part of our efforts to build a diverse workforce, we encourage applications from Indigenous, Black, and other racialized communities, 2SLGBTQIA+ communities, people with neurodivergence, immigrants, people with disabilities, and other equity deserving groups. In addition to building a diverse workforce, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible experience.
